semantic_contract.height: worldZ = localShapeHeight * heightScaleWorld + heightBiasWorld; HM.R = worldZ / 64 at authored scale
semantic_contract.root: rootAnchor [0.5,1.0] is exact Z=0 for current standing sprites
semantic_contract.materialAO: intra-object cavity only; scene GTAO/SSGI remains a separate visibility term
semantic_contract.materialClassification: semantic prior owns broad response; source colour only supplies bounded within-class wear

painted_steel.intent: dielectric paint over steel; exposed metal is a bounded chip detail

rusted_steel.intent: oxidised steel; rust is rough and mostly dielectric

galvanized.intent: zinc-coated steel with broad metallic response

glass.intent: smooth dielectric glass; transmission remains a later renderer concern

wet_concrete.intent: dielectric mineral surface with lower roughness

water.intent: dielectric water; procedural water owns transmission/reflection

box.intent: front/top/side planes with bounded lips and recesses

pole.intent: narrow cylinder rooted at the sprite foot

frame.intent: independent frame members; alpha gaps remain gaps

pipe.intent: separate cylindrical runs; alpha gaps remain gaps

robot.intent: articulated macro body with restrained panel relief
